Rules
1. Do not run the PHP here, I'll run it in Laragon.
2. Only follow the established style.
3. Ensure no unreadable elements are implemented (e.g White text on white background / black text in black background)
4. When making a modal. Ensure this: Never use the browser one. Make an actual native to our webpages modal. This includes the warning. Confirmations and so on.
5. If the user ask something for example a task, ensure that you check for any existing similar system/features first before doing it, if it exist. Do something that is close to that system but appropriate to the request so that there will be some sort of consistency.
